name: Decline Dumbbell Triceps Extension
how_to:
Setup
1. Lie down on a decline bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
3. Extend your arms fully above your chest with a slight bend at the elbows.
Execution
1. While keeping your upper arms perpendicular to the floor, bend your elbows slowly to lower the dumbbells toward the sides of your head.
2. Keep your elbows fixed in place and do not let them flare outward.
3. Lower until you feel a deep stretch in the triceps.
4. Reverse the movement by extending your elbows and pressing the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
5. Repeat for your desired number of repetitions.
Reps and Sets
- Beginners: 3 sets of 8–10 reps
- Intermediate to Advanced: 3 to 4 sets of 10–15 reps
